title: Parker Helicopters

services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Parker Helicopters combines experienced pilots, a modern helicopter, and a tailored flight experience. Our four Utah-based tours feature Salt Lake City, the Wasatch Mountains, Antelope Island, and a Catch All tour, offering distinct views of the region’s landscapes. From urban landmarks to rugged peaks and open lake views, every flight is designed to showcase Utah's diversity from above. Salt Lake City offers a unique blend of urban landscape and natural surroundings, set against the backdrop of the Wasatch Mountains. From above, you’ll take in a clear view of the city’s downtown core, including Temple Square and the Utah State Capitol, before following the shoreline of the Great Salt Lake.
